assets.title: Nine savanna test animals
assets.provenance: Text prompts generated nine species through Amy's Meshy API account at her explicit request. Meshy T2 geometry and Meshy 7.1 textures. Per-model task IDs, source and optimized hashes, sizes and geometry counts are recorded in the batch manifest. No account balance or credential is published.
assets.reviewStatus: Static AI-generated art tests available in the animal preview gallery. Species anatomy, animation, educational encounters and distribution terms still require their respective review; no license or scientific approval is inferred.

assets.title: Soph walking character
assets.provenance: Supplied by Amy on 2026-09-20 for use as the playable explorer. Export metadata identifies Blender; no creator or license metadata is embedded, so no third-party authorship or license is inferred.
assets.modifications: Opaque 2048px PNG resized to 1024px JPEG; geometry, skin and animation buffers preserved. Runtime normalizes height/orientation and makes a copy of the walk clip with horizontal root travel removed so collision controls own movement.
assets.reviewStatus: User-supplied prototype character with embedded walk. License metadata not supplied; provenance recorded without an inferred license.

assets.title: Zebra Portrait
assets.creator: amyleerobinson
assets.provenance: Amy supplied the textured GLB export from her Meshy model. Public share page credits amyleerobinson and lists CC BY 4.0. Source generation labels: Smart Topology + Meshy T2 + Meshy 7 (Texture).
assets.modifications: Three embedded 2048 x 2048 JPEG textures resized to 1024 x 1024 and re-encoded at quality 90, 4:4:4. Geometry, indices and UVs preserved. Game normalizes scale/orientation and applies approximate procedural poses.
assets.reviewStatus: AI-generated prototype supplied by creator; species anatomy and procedural motion require wildlife-expert review. Not a production animation rig.
